subject: v1.1 Phase 9 task 9.4 (attempt 2) - Bounded post-save reconciliation trigger (ADR-016 clause 5 second bullet)

findings.description: New RegistratorRegistersThePostSaveTriggerAsAHostedService calls the real ArrTagsServiceRegistrator.RegisterServices, builds a provider, resolves IEnumerable<IHostedService>, asserts Assert.Single(hosted.OfType<ConfigurationReconciliationTrigger>()), and Assert.Same against both IConfigurationReconciliationTrigger and ConfigurationReconciliationTrigger. Non-vacuity is structural (only AddHostedService registers IHostedService) and was reproduced by temporarily removing the registration line (Assert.Single failed).

New StopAsyncIsBoundedWhenTheReconciliationIsBlocked blocks the enumerator with a cancellation-immune wait, asserts StopAsync returns within a 4s bound and under 4s (2s harness shutdown bound), then asserts via a bounded stability poll that no hint is enqueued.

New ValidButUnactivatedSaveRequestsNoReconciliation uses SaveHarness(registerSnapshotService: false); asserts LastConfigurationValidationResult.IsValid is true and trigger.RequestCount == 0. The meaningful assertion is RequestCount == 0.

findings.disposition: CLOSED - vacuous assertions removed, load-bearing one retained
findings.description: The vacuous Assert.False(release.IsSet)/Assert.Empty(Hints) were removed; the bounded save.WaitAsync(5s) before release.Set() remains the genuine non-blocking assertion.

findings.disposition: CLOSED - fixed delay replaced by bounded stability poll
findings.description: The Task.Delay(200) negative assertion was replaced by AssertStableAsync(expected: 2, stabilityMilliseconds: 300), which is strictly stronger and cannot observe a pre-increment value.
The overstating RegistratorWiresThePostSaveTriggerWithoutStartupWork was removed and superseded by the TQ-1 hosted-registration test, which also asserts IWorkHintSink.Count == 0 after resolution.
No single fact composes Plugin.UpdateConfiguration -> real trigger -> re-render; the two halves remain individually covered. Residual optional gap, not a false-confidence risk.

docs/limitations.md V6 (and docs/release/build-and-release.md) still report the 1.0.1.0 matrix while the v1.1 working suite is now 1270/63/1333. Release/documentation task owned; outside task 9.4's acceptance criteria.
